write_up: It's common for a dispatch resume to list daily duties like this. Yours shows a move from warehouse work to Dispatch Assistant and then Dispatcher at Crossroads Regional Freight, but the recent lines don't say how much work you handle or how you handle it. That makes it tough to stand out among other dispatchers.

The load tracking and customer update line is your best model: it names the work and who receives the information. Your dates and progression are easy to follow, and McLeod TMS is already named in your skills.

Let's start with the Dispatcher role. Add how many drivers you dispatch and what you do when problems come up, then give the safety and TMS lines the same treatment. A short description of Crossroads can also give a recruiter some context.
